title: Our duty to stay healthy
intro: Health is one of Allah’s great blessings – we thank Him for it and take care of it.

learn.title: 📖 In the Qur’an
learn.html: Allah tells us that if we tried to count His blessings, we could never count them. <small>(Qur’an, Ibrahim 14:34)</small>

Allah has given us more blessings than we can count, and health is one of the greatest. So every person – and especially every Muslim – must be thankful for it. Besides being thankful, our duty is to look after our health, because it is needed for a happy, successful life. Some people only understand the value of health when they lose it.

learn.title: Hadith
learn.html: The Prophet (SAW) said: “There are two blessings that many people neglect: health and free time.” (Bukhari)

learn.text: To look after our health we:

items: do what Allah commanded, like Salah and fasting
do what Allah allowed, like sleeping and resting
keep away from haram – everything Allah forbade, like alcohol and drugs
keep clean and tidy – personal hygiene is especially important
eat healthily – a variety of the food our parents give us, fewer sweets and fizzy drinks
work in moderation – too much work harms the body
sleep in moderation – go to bed and get up on time
do sport and exercise – to stay fit, grow, rest from work and enjoy Allah’s nature
get treatment when we are ill – it is our duty to seek a cure

learn.title: ⭐ Remember
learn.html: A healthy mind in a healthy body!

practice.title: Healthy or harmful?
practice.prompt: Does this look after our health or harm it?

items.text: Going to the doctor when ill
Staying up all night on a phone

questions.q: Which two blessings do many people neglect?
